Welcome to WAKE

Measure the Wake, Master the Watch.

The OOD Training Continuum

WAKE is an offline TORIS-to-OOD readiness tool that uses imported TORIS data to show command readiness, officer progression, and watchstanding attention areas.

Use it to review WAKE/OOD-TC levels, qualified OOD hours, recency, local proficiency grades, SWOMAN currency refresh needs, Rules of the Road records, officer profiles, grading, and watchbill risk before assigning watches.

First time using WAKE? Start with the interactive coach. It stays beside the app, tells you what each area means, and points to the next useful click.

LevelsShows where each watchstander stands in the continuum.
CurrencyFlags local 45-90 Need Currency and SWOMAN refresh requirements.
ProficiencyUses WAKE gradeable evolutions and 2+ hour SWOMAN refresh evidence.
RORTracks Rules of the Road score, date, remediation, and 20-question minimum.
GapsShows what is still needed before level progression.

Interactive User Guide

Use the guided coach for the first run. It follows the area you click, explains why the view matters, and points to the next action without blocking normal WAKE work.

Start Here

Use Import TORIS first. After data loads, Ship Overview shows OOD levels, command metrics, risk cards, charts, and the roster table.

Review People

Use the Roster tab to search, filter, and open officer profiles. Profiles keep the existing logs, grades, ROR, letter export, transfer, and CO override actions.

Command Tools

Use Export Backup as a regular Start Here action to protect offline browser-stored data. Use CO Mass Grading for bulk grade/ROR work, Watchbill Risk for assigned-watch readiness, and More Actions for references, overview, or local data reset.

Interactive Walkthrough

The coach is built for first-time users: it explains the operational value of each screen, shows what to look for, and recommends the next click while still letting users explore freely.

Level 0

  • WAKE/OOD-TC local level, not a SWOMAN level.
  • 0-100 OOD Q Hours.
  • Only qualified OOD (Q) hours apply to level movement. Cumulative CONN, JOOD, and OOD hours remain tracked separately.
  • Not OOD qualified on current ship, or currency lost after more than 90 days since last qualifying bridge watch.

Level 1

  • WAKE/OOD-TC local level.
  • 100-300 OOD Q Hours.
  • Must have at least one OOD U/W watch labeled Q in the tracker.
  • Current before day 45; 45-90 days is a local Need Currency alert and SWOMAN refresh review window, but does not force Level 0.
  • Basic requirements begin tracking toward next level.

Level 2

  • WAKE/OOD-TC local level.
  • 300-800 OOD Q Hours.
  • Must have at least one OOD U/W watch labeled Q in the tracker.
  • All Basic Evolutions met in the named position: OOD requirements require Q OOD logs; CONN requirements require Q CONN logs; Flight Quarters requires an OOD log.
  • Basic Evolutions graded at least 3.

Level 3

  • WAKE/OOD-TC local level.
  • 800-1110 OOD Q Hours displayed; 1110 is a continuum display target, not an added level gate.
  • Must have at least one OOD U/W watch labeled Q in the tracker.
  • Basic Evolutions graded at least 4.
  • At least 50% of Advanced Evolutions completed with 3 logged occurrences each; Advanced Evolutions are not graded.

Experience

Only qualified OOD (Q) hours are applied to level movement. Cumulative CONN, JOOD, and OOD hours remain tracked and displayed separately. Level 0: 0-100, Level 1: 100-300, Level 2: 300-800, Level 3: 800-1110 display range. Level 3 is earned at 800+ OOD Q Hours plus Level 3 requirements; 1110 is display-only. Other watchstation hours are stored, reported, and exported but do not change bridge level.

Currency

Bridge watch currency is Current at 0-44 days, local Need Currency at 45-90 days, and Currency Loss at greater than 90 days. SWOMAN refresh evidence uses 2+ hour underway/special watches, SET sessions in NSST/IBNS, and ROR only for >90 refresh. The manual window is 46-90; WAKE keeps the conservative local day-45 alert.

Proficiency

WAKE level proficiency uses required evolutions and CO grades. SWOMAN watchstanding proficiency excludes CO/XO, requires at least 2 hours for a watch or SET to count, and lets an OOD watch satisfy JOOD/CONN proficiency where applicable.

Recency

Ship-wide view of how recently required evolutions were conducted. CO overrides with dates are included in recency tracking.

OOD-TC Proficiency Grading Scale

Assessments are conducted by the Commanding Officer, Executive Officer, or Senior Watch Officer using the following 1-5 scale:

1 - Training Deficiency: Critical gaps in basic shiphandling, navigation rules, or bridge team management.

2 - Knowledge Gaps: Inconsistent application of directives, sluggish response to tactical or contact changes.

3 - Proficient: Demonstrated tactical knowledge, solid shiphandling, and sound decision-making under normal conditions.

4 - Highly Effective: Successfully overcame unexpected bridge challenges, weather, or equipment casualties.

5 - Excellence: Mastery of shiphandling, tactical maneuvering, and flawless leadership under extreme stress.

Data AreaHow It Works
Watchstation DataShip Overview uses all watchstations by default. Individual watchstation data remains available in officer logs, profiles, and exports.
CO OverrideUse the CO Override checkbox. Basic requirements include inline date and score fields. Advanced requirements use the checkbox only and do not create a grade, TORIS log, or artificial hours.
Export CSVExports every watch/log entry, officer level, hours, events, special conditions, grades, manual requirements, and status fields for re-import or fleet tracker reporting.
Special ConditionsGeneral Quarters, Low Visibility, and Astern Refueling remain visible in logs/exports but do not automatically satisfy a qualification requirement.
